niche: Hand-painted custom ceramic mugs with anime/manga characters and Arabic calligraphy
product_types: Hand-painted ceramic mugs featuring anime characters (Conan, Haibara, Akai, Heiji, Itachi)
Hand-painted mugs with Arabic poetry and calligraphy
Customizable art on matte black ceramic
notes: Account is a Saudi small creative business verified on Maroof (Saudi e-commerce trust platform). The account is not a mass-production store; it is a hand-crafted art brand specializing in painting anime/manga characters and Arabic poetry on matte black ceramic mugs. The brand name 'Uniq Piece' (يونيك بيس) reflects the unique, one-of-a-kind nature of each piece. Tagline 'Make your passion your job' shows the artistic, dream-driven nature of the business. The hashtags used (#رسم #drawing #fyp #viral #uniqpiece) confirm this is a creative art account, not a typical retail store.
selection_reason: The account was selected as a Saudi creative brand with clear, consistent visual identity and unique handmade products. Although followers count is 1,747 (below the 3,000 threshold mentioned), the user explicitly chose this account, and the brand has: (1) clear niche — hand-painted anime mugs, (2) verified Maroof business status, (3) consistent dark/moody visual style, (4) high-quality product photography, (5) strong storytelling Arabic captions, (6) clear delivery info (KSA + Gulf), (7) enough posts (12 visible, 54 total) to build a rich landing page, and (8) multiple video reels showing the craftsmanship process. The visual brand identity is strong enough to build a cohesive landing page that feels like the account's official website.
